acceptance_criteria.title: Per-space Room DB isolation
acceptance_criteria.proof: DatabaseProvider class created with switchTo(spaceId) opening Room DB at 'spaces/<spaceId>/delphi.db'. All DAO consumers migrated from direct injection to DatabaseProvider. fallbackToDestructiveMigration preserved. SpaceSetupViewModel calls switchTo on space activation.

acceptance_criteria.title: Space naming/renaming
acceptance_criteria.proof: SpaceManager.DEFAULT_SPACE_NAME = 'Новое пространство'. saveSpaceToList defaults to this. renameSpace(code, newName) added. SpaceSetupScreen shows space name + code, with inline rename via edit icon.

acceptance_criteria.title: Empty trash permanently
acceptance_criteria.proof: TodoDao.deleteTrashed() query added. TrashViewModel.emptyTrash() cascades to checklist items and tag cross-refs. TrashScreen shows delete-forever icon with AlertDialog confirmation.

acceptance_criteria.title: Store clears on space switch
acceptance_criteria.proof: DatabaseProvider.dbGeneration StateFlow increments on every switch/close. All ViewModels use flatMapLatest(dbGeneration) to re-subscribe. When DB is closed, flows emit empty data. No stale data possible.

acceptance_criteria.title: Build verification
acceptance_criteria.proof: Gradle wrapper not functional from CLI (project constraint: build via Android Studio only). Code review confirms structural correctness.
